name: Epic Timeblade

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus : +6 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: Improved Paralyzing
effects.tooltip: Improved Paralyzing : Any creature struck by this weapon must succeed on a DC 28 Will save or be paralyzed. The target may attempt a new save to end the effect every several seconds; otherwise the paralysis lasts for 1 minute.

effects.name: Doublestrike
effects.tooltip: Doublestrike 11% : Passive: 11% Enhancement bonus to Doublestrike. (Doublestrike is a chance to score an additional hit with a melee attack.)

effects.name: Improved Slowburst
effects.tooltip: Improved Slowburst : This weapon has an image of a snail worked into its hilt or grip, and it feels cold to the touch. Whenever you score a critical hit with this weapon, the target is slowed for 30 seconds. A DC 28 Will save negates this effect.

effects.name: Freedom of Movement
effects.tooltip: Freedom of Movement : This item grants its wearer the ability to move and attack normally while under the influence of magic that impedes movement, such as paralysis, solid fog, slow and web.

effects.name: Feather Falling
effects.tooltip: Feather Falling : This item is engraved with feathers and bestows a powerful magical effect. Whenever the wearer begins to fall from any height, this effect slows the descent dramatically, causing the wearer to fall like a feather.

flavor_text: A sword gifted with the power to bend time. Powerful blows against your enemies will slow their actions, and if you are falling and in danger it will slow your descent so that you land safely.
